name: sorcerer
lore:
A sorcerer is not a student of the arcane, but its living vessel. They are biological anomalies, born of bloodlines touched by draconic fire, celestial grace, or the chaotic fringes of the Outer Planes. To a sorcerer, magic is not a formula found in dusty grimoires, but an atavistic pulse—a second heartbeat that thrums with raw, unrefined power.

In behavior, they are often as volatile as the forces they command. While the wizard calculates, the sorcerer feels, channeling the Weave through sheer force of personality. They do not request the fire to burn; they command it by right of birth. This innate potency often breeds a restless disposition, as the magic within constantly seeks egress. Whether solitary recluses or magnetic leaders, they move through the world as walking conduits, proving that for some, reality is not a set of laws, but a suggestion.
